text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 Pager: High GPU queue growth on prod-inference, autoscaler alerts firing. Paging @anna_oncall.

anna_oncall: Oncall Anna here — acked. Jumping in. What's the current gamma? :mag_right:

mike_sre: Queue length on GPU pool 'gpool-prod-west' spiked at 06:12 UTC. Ingress is throttling. Grafana shows custom_metric_inference_queue_per_node rising from 2 -> 18 in 6m. Autoscaler alerts: HPA decisions not scaling due to missing custom metrics.

jamie_runtime: I'm seeing errors from prometheus-adapter: "error querying custom metrics: context deadline exceeded". Also metrics-server pods in kube-system are Restarting. Might be a metrics pipeline issue.

anna_oncall: Can someone paste HPA status?

mike_sre: paste: ```
NAME                            REFERENCE                       TARGETS         MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
inference-worker-hpa            Deployment/inference-worker     0/50 (<unknown>) 2         50        2
```

mike_sre: HPA shows `<unknown>` for metrics — it won't scale without metrics. kubectl describe shows: ```
Events:
  Type    Reason             Age   From                       Message
  ----    ------             ----  ----                       -------
  Warning FailedGetMetrics   2m    horizontal-pod-autoscaler  failed to get cpu utilization: unable to get metrics for resource custom.metrics.k8s.io: no metrics returned from custom metrics API
```

jamie_runtime: Prometheus-adapter logs: ```
E0324 06:11:12.123456 1 server.go:200] unable to fetch metrics: context deadline exceeded
E0324 06:11:12.223456 1 main.go:89] scrape timeout, queue backlog=125000
```

kim_platform: We're also seeing Prometheus remote_write backlog growth after a brief cluster-wide networking blip 06:05 UTC. Adapter times out when querying Prom for recent series. metrics-server crashloop is separate (kubelet cert rotation) — will restart and watch.

anna_oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) throttle incoming new requests at the gateway to reduce queue growth 2) manually scale inference workers to buy time 3) spin emergency GPU nodes if needed 4) restart prometheus-adapter and metrics-server. Who can run the manual scale?

mike_sre: I'll manually scale the deployment now to relieve queue. Running: ```
kubectl scale deploy/redwood-inference-worker --replicas=20 -n inference
kubectl get pods -l app=redwood-inference-worker -n inference
```

ops-bot: Deploy job started by mike_sre.

anna_oncall: Throttling rule applied at ingress (rate-limit for non-critical keys). Liz, please prep customer notice.

liz_support: On it — sending short customer-facing notice to affected accounts. Template: "We're investigating higher latency/503s on inference; temporary throttling and mitigation in progress. We'll update in 15m." :white_check_mark:

jamie_runtime: Restarting prometheus-adapter now: ```
kubectl rollout restart deployment prometheus-adapter -n monitoring
kubectl rollout status deployment prometheus-adapter -n monitoring --timeout=2m
```

kim_platform: metrics-server restart also triggered. Watching pods. If adapter can't query Prom within 3m, we'll need to scale Prometheus or increase adapter query timeout.

mike_sre: Node pool autoscaler not triggering because HPA hasn't requested nodes (no metrics), so I'm opening a manual node group scale: `gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize gpool-prod-west --size 8` (from 4). ETA nodes ~7m.

anna_oncall: Good. Any evidence of model fallback kicking in? We have canary CPU-only model we can route some traffic to. Suggest shifting 20% of non-paid traffic to cpu-variant. Jamie, can you open a routing rollback?

jamie_runtime: Routing change pushed to edge: `traffic-split: inference-prod -> cpu-variant 20%` — monitoring now.

mike_sre: After manual scale to 20 replicas, queue length dropped by ~60% in 3m. Latency for queued requests improved but 503s still at ~2% for heavy customers.

liz_support: Notified top 5 accounts by email + support DMs. Tracking incident in Zendesk.

anna_oncall: OK — current snapshot: HPA not scaling automatically due to missing custom metrics (prometheus-adapter timeouts) + metrics-server instability. Manual scaling + node group resize + ingress throttling + traffic-split are holding. Customer impact: degraded performance and intermittent 503s for ~12% of requests during peak.

ops-bot: Incident: created incident/INC-2026-0423 (prod-inference-autoscale) — severity SEV2.

kim_platform: Adapter logs show queries timing out because Prometheus is overloaded; will increase adapter query timeout to 30s and scale adapter to 3 replicas. Also increasing Prometheus query frontend replicas and checking retention.

jamie_runtime: I can take postmortem owner. I'll collect runbook steps and timeline. Action items: (1) fix metrics-server cert rotation automation (2) add circuit-breaker to HPA when metrics unavailable (3) make adapter query timeout configurable per cluster AND (4) improve runbook for manual GPU node resize.

mike_sre: Handing off active incident to me for the next 20m while Anna loops out. I'll continue until we have stable autoscaling and metrics recovered. @anna_oncall if you need me to stay longer ping me.

anna_oncall: Thanks, Mike. I'll stay on call until Prometheus-adapter reports healthy metrics and HPA shows normal targets. Otherwise, I'll rejoin. :thumbsup:

jamie_runtime: Note for post-incident: consider fallback where HPA reads queue-length from ingestion service directly if custom metrics pipeline is down.

liz_support: Next update scheduled in 15 minutes. Communicated ETA for engineering mitigation ~20m.

incident-bot: Handoff: active -> mike_sre at 06:28 UTC.

mike_sre: Monitoring: prometheus-adapter rolled to 3 replicas, query timeout 30s. Metrics now returning, HPA target updated to 32/50. Node group resize in progress. Observability panels show queue trending down.

anna_oncall: Great work. Keep me posted on full recovery. Postmortem owner: jamie_runtime. I'll add on-call blameless note and link to incident Slack thread.

jamie_runtime: Will open postmortem doc and assign follow-ups.

ops-bot: Incident closed by mike_sre after stabilization and customer mitigation. Will mark as incident => follow-up required.

mike_sre: Final notes before closing thread: root cause: metrics pipeline (prometheus -> prometheus-adapter) timeout/backlog + metrics-server instability. Immediate cause of capacity exhaustion: HPA couldn't read custom queue metrics, so autoscaling didn't request more replicas or nodes. Postmortem items created.

anna_oncall: Thanks team. :pray:

(End of thread)
